R command:

hierarchia: 1. death days_death

2\. HF hosp days_hf

3\. LVESV 15% változás - responder 0/1

4\. BNP_change_5 - 0/1

ahol LVESV és BNP hiányzó adat van azt NA-nak tekinti, maradjon- e így vagy akik életben maradtak és hiányzott adat ott 0-nak vegyük?

\> library(haven)

\> library(dplyr)

\> library(janitor)

\> library(hce)

\>

\> # ---- Read & clean ----

\> dat_raw <- read_dta("Desktop/stata_bud.dta") # use / or \\\\ on Windows

\> dat &lt;- dat_raw %&gt;% clean_names()

\>

\> # If you ever get per-subject follow-up (e.g., 'days_fu'), use it; else default 365.

\> alive_fu <- if ("days_fu" %in% names(dat)) pmin(as.numeric(dat\$days_fu), 365) else rep(365, nrow(dat))

\>

\> # ---- Build HCE (best -> worst) & time-aware AVAL ----

\> dat_prep &lt;- dat %&gt;%

\+ transmute(

\+ USUBJID = as.character(number),

\+ TRTP = as.factor(trt),

\+ died = as.numeric(died2), # 1=died, 0=alive

\+ hfh = as.numeric(hfh), # 1=HFH, 0=no HFH

\+ resp = as.numeric(responder), # 1 better

\+ bnp5 = as.numeric(bnp_change_5), # 1 better

\+ days_death = as.numeric(days_death),

\+ days_hf = as.numeric(days_hf)

\+ ) %>%

\+ mutate(

\+ died = ifelse(is.na(died), 0, died),

\+ hfh = ifelse(is.na(hfh), 0, hfh),

\+ resp = ifelse(is.na(resp), 0, resp),

\+ bnp5 = ifelse(is.na(bnp5), 0, bnp5),

+

\+ # Follow-up time used for alive/no-HFH subjects

\+ fu_alive = ifelse(died == 0 & hfh == 0, alive_fu, NA_real_),

+

\+ # HCE category (BEST -> WORST order defined below)

\+ HCE = case_when(

\+ died == 1 ~ "Death",

\+ hfh == 1 ~ "HFH",

\+ resp == 1 & bnp5 == 1 ~ "Alive_noHFH_resp1_BNP1",

\+ resp == 1 & bnp5 == 0 ~ "Alive_noHFH_resp1_BNP0",

\+ resp == 0 & bnp5 == 1 ~ "Alive_noHFH_resp0_BNP1",

\+ TRUE ~ "Alive_noHFH_resp0_BNP0"

\+ ),

\+ HCE = factor(

\+ HCE,

\+ levels = c(

\+ "Alive_noHFH_resp1_BNP1",

\+ "Alive_noHFH_resp1_BNP0",

\+ "Alive_noHFH_resp0_BNP1",

\+ "Alive_noHFH_resp0_BNP0",

\+ "HFH",

\+ "Death"

\+ )

\+ ),

+

\+ # AVAL (higher = better): time-aware within each tier

\+ # - Alive/no-HFH: larger follow-up better

\+ # - HFH: later HFH better (use days_hf)

\+ # - Death: later death better (use days_death)

\+ AVAL = case_when(

\+ HCE == "Alive_noHFH_resp1_BNP1" ~ 2400 + coalesce(fu_alive, 0),

\+ HCE == "Alive_noHFH_resp1_BNP0" ~ 2300 + coalesce(fu_alive, 0),

\+ HCE == "Alive_noHFH_resp0_BNP1" ~ 2200 + coalesce(fu_alive, 0),

\+ HCE == "Alive_noHFH_resp0_BNP0" ~ 2100 + coalesce(fu_alive, 0),

\+ HCE == "HFH" ~ 1000 + coalesce(days_hf, 0),

\+ HCE == "Death" ~ 0 + coalesce(days_death, 0)

\+ ),

+

\+ # Optional columns (quiet some warnings)

\+ AVAL0 = NA_real_,

\+ PADY = case_when(

\+ HCE == "Death" ~ days_death,

\+ HCE == "HFH" ~ days_hf,

\+ TRUE ~ coalesce(fu_alive, 365)

\+ )

\+ ) %>%

\+ select(USUBJID, TRTP, HCE, AVAL, AVAL0, PADY)

\>

\> # ---- hce object & win statistics ----

\> hce_obj <- as_hce(dat_prep, id = "USUBJID", trt = "TRTP", hce = "HCE", aval = "AVAL")

\> wins <- calcWINS(hce_obj)

\>

másik command sor: We don't impute responder or BNP_change_5. If responder is missing, the code skips to BNP; if BNP is missing too, the pair is a tie.

\> # Returns +1 if a beats b, -1 if b beats a, 0 if tie.

\> .compare_pair <- function(a, b) {

\+ # 1) Death layer (tf days_death)

\+ a_died <- as.integer(a\[\["Died2"\]\]) == 1

\+ b_died <- as.integer(b\[\["Died2"\]\]) == 1

\+ if (a_died || b_died) {

\+ if (a_died && !b_died) return(-1)

\+ if (!a_died && b_died) return(+1)

\+ # both died: later death is better

\+ ad <- a\[\["days_death"\]\]; bd <- b\[\["days_death"\]\]

\+ if (!is.na(ad) && !is.na(bd)) {

\+ if (ad > bd) return(+1)

\+ if (ad < bd) return(-1)

\+ }

\+ return(0) # same day or a/b missing -> tie

\+ }

+

\+ # 2) HFH layer (tf days_HF)

\+ a_hf <- as.integer(a\[\["HFH"\]\]) == 1

\+ b_hf <- as.integer(b\[\["HFH"\]\]) == 1

\+ if (a_hf || b_hf) {

\+ if (a_hf && !b_hf) return(-1)

\+ if (!a_hf && b_hf) return(+1)

\+ # both had HFH: later is better

\+ ah <- a\[\["days_HF"\]\]; bh <- b\[\["days_HF"\]\]

\+ if (!is.na(ah) && !is.na(bh)) {

\+ if (ah > bh) return(+1)

\+ if (ah < bh) return(-1)

\+ }

\+ return(0)

\+ }

+

\+ # 3) Symptom layer: responder first (c >), then BNP_change_5 (c >)

\+ ar <- a\[\["responder"\]\]; br <- b\[\["responder"\]\]

\+ if (!is.na(ar) && !is.na(br)) {

\+ if (ar > br) return(+1)

\+ if (ar < br) return(-1)

\+ # equal responder -> fall through to BNP

\+ } else {

\+ # responder missing for at least one -> fall through to BNP

\+ }

+

\+ # 4) BNP (higher = better). Keep NA (no imputation).

\+ ab <- a\[\["BNP_change_5"\]\]; bb <- b\[\["BNP_change_5"\]\]

\+ if (!is.na(ab) && !is.na(bb)) {

\+ if (ab > bb) return(+1)

\+ if (ab < bb) return(-1)

\+ }

\+ return(0) # equal or missing -> tie

\+ }

\>

\> # ----- Win statistics over all treatment-control pairs (all-vs-all) -----

\> # df: your data.frame with columns:

\> # Number (patient id), trt (two-level treatment), Died2, days_death, HFH, days_HF,

\> # responder, BNP_change_5

\> # ref: the reference/control level in df\[\[trt\]\] (e.g., 0, "0", "Placebo", "P")

\> win_stats_hierarchy <- function(df, id_col = "Number", trt_col = "trt", ref) {

\+ stopifnot(all(c("Died2","days_death","HFH","days_HF","responder","BNP_change_5") %in% names(df)))

+

\+ trt_vec <- df\[\[trt_col\]\]

\+ ctrl_idx <- which(trt_vec == ref)

\+ trt_idx <- which(trt_vec != ref)

+

\+ if (length(ctrl_idx) == 0 || length(trt_idx) == 0) {

\+ stop("Both treatment and reference groups must be present.")

\+ }

+

\+ W <- L <- Ties <- 0L

+

\+ # Loop over all treatment-control pairs

\+ for (i in trt_idx) {

\+ a <- df\[i, , drop = FALSE\]

\+ for (j in ctrl_idx) {

\+ b <- df\[j, , drop = FALSE\]

\+ cmp <- .compare_pair(a, b)

\+ if (cmp > 0) W <- W + 1L else if (cmp < 0) L <- L + 1L else Ties <- Ties + 1L

\+ }

\+ }

+

\+ Npairs <- W + L + Ties

\+ WP <- (W + 0.5 \* Ties) / Npairs # Win Probability (treatment vs ref)

\+ WO <- WP / (1 - WP) # Win Odds

\+ WR <- if (L == 0L) Inf else W / L # Win Ratio

\+ NB <- 2 \* WP - 1 # Net Benefit (equivalently (W - L)/Npairs)

+

\+ list(

\+ counts = c(Wins = W, Losses = L, Ties = Ties, Pairs = Npairs),

\+ estimates = c(WinProbability = WP, WinOdds = WO, WinRatio = WR, NetBenefit = NB)

\+ )

\+ }

\> View(wins)
